name: KevlinX BRU01
notes: First large data center in Brussels-Capital Region, live since Jan 2026. Galilei site of citydev.brussels, Avenue Antoon Van Oss, Neder-Over-Heembeek (1120 Brussels). 32 MW+ AI-ready campus design; BESIX handed over Dec 2025; BREEAM-aligned; low-latency (<5ms) to UK/NL/DE/FR. Capacity is campus design; phase-1 IT load reported 4-16 MW depending on source.

name: Datacenter United DC Evere
notes: Carlistraat 2, 1140 Evere (Brussels-Capital). Former Proximus NetCenter; part of the Oct-2024 announced, Q1-2025 closed acquisition of four Proximus data centers (Evere, Mechelen, Machelen) for EUR 128M. Carrier-neutral colocation; only commercial colo DC in Brussels-Capital per datacenters.com. Permit status not separately verified.

name: Microsoft Azure Belgium Central cloud region
notes: Azure Belgium Central opened 2025-11-18 (announced in Brussels). Physical datacenter buildings are undisclosed, so recorded only at region level; per BE methodology a cloud region is not counted as a facility. Recheck official region pages each run.

name: Digital Realty BRU1
notes: Wezembeekstraat 2, 1930 Zaventem (Flemish Brabant). Operator page lists ~5,000 m2. 'Brussels' marketing label; per methodology assigned to Flanders by municipality.

name: Digital Realty BRU3
notes: Mercuriusstraat 27, 1930 Zaventem; ~1,470 m2 per operator. Directory (Inflect) reports 144 MW connection power - unverified, treated as C.

name: Digital Realty BRU4
notes: Mercuriusstraat 27, 1930 Zaventem; ~6,700 m2 per operator page.

name: AtlasEdge BRU001 (ex-Colt Brussels)
notes: Mercuriusstraat 30, 1930 Nossegem/Zaventem (Flanders). 3,300+ m2, 7.5 MVA, ISO-certified, 100% green energy per AtlasEdge fact sheet/LinkedIn; formerly Colt Brussels. Capacity from operator material (B), directory corroboration (C).

name: LCL Brussels-North (Diegem)
notes: Kouterveldstraat 13, 1831 Diegem (Machelen). LCL's largest/best-connected Belgian facility; EUR 30M expansion (2024-25) to new Tier III capacity; PeeringDB fac 193; ECX Fabric available.

name: LCL Brussels-West (Aalst)
notes: Aalst/Erembodegem (Flanders). Tier III certification; part of LCL EUR 120M expansion program covering Aalst and Diegem.

name: LCL Brussels-South (Huizingen)
notes: Huizingen (Beersel, Flemish Brabant). Atos facility transferred to LCL management in 2020 and rebranded LCL Brussels-South; ~300 m2 / 120 racks per directory.

name: LCL Antwerp
notes: One of LCL's five Belgian data centers (Diegem, Aalst, Huizingen, Antwerp, Gembloux) per LCL; directory places site at Noorderlaan 133, Antwerp (C). Address/permit not re-verified this run.

name: Penta Infra BRU01 (Nexus)
notes: Zone 1 Research Park 340, Asse / Zellik Research Park (Flemish Brabant, Flanders) - 8-storey facility covered in PV facade (up to 360 kW on-site solar per ITdaily). BREEAM Excellent, EDGE Advanced, Uptime Tier III certified (Ingenium). Formerly Ghelamco's Nexus DC acquired by Penta Infra/Photon Capital. 7.2 MW figure is directory-grade (C).

name: EdgeConneX Brussels (Ternat)
notes: Ternat, <15-18 km from downtown Brussels (Flanders). 20 MW campus per trade press (JSA) and Baxtel; operator page confirms campus location. Baxtel ranks it largest Brussels-market facility at 20 MW (C corroboration).

name: Datacenter United DC Antwerp (Burcht)
notes: DCU Antwerp is Belgium's first and only Uptime Tier IV certified data center (operator + Uptime client story). DC Star Burcht site acquired 2022 (Baxtel). Operator lists Antwerp among 14 DCs / 12 Belgian locations.

name: Datacenter United DC Machelen
notes: Acquired from Proximus in the 2024/2025 four-DC deal (Evere, Mechelen, Machelen). Operator page confirms DC Machelen. Permit/address not separately re-verified.

name: Datacenter United DC Ghent (Merelbeke)
notes: DCU lists Ghent among Belgian locations; DC Star Ghent site (Industriepark 2H, 9820 Merelbeke per directory) acquired 2022. Facility address from directory (C).

name: Datacenter United DC Mechelen
notes: Acquired from Proximus (2024/2025). Operator page confirms DC Mechelen.

name: Datacenter United DC Hasselt
notes: Operator page confirms DC Hasselt; directory places site at Veldstraat 101, 3500 Hasselt (C).

name: Datacenter United DC Oostkamp/Bruges
notes: Brugsestraat 196/1, Oostkamp (near Bruges); DC Star Oostkamp site acquired 2022. Address from datacentermap (C), operator page confirms location.

name: Datacenter United DC Kortrijk
notes: Construction reported started on the southern axis of Kortrijk (2023). Status needs re-confirmation; trade press repeated that work had begun.

name: KBC Mechelen data center
notes: Replacement data center at KBC Campus Mechelen; environmental permit applied 2024 and building permits reported secured (BDIA). Construction status not re-confirmed in this run's searches.

name: KBC Heist-op-den-Berg data center
notes: Second KBC replacement data center planned for Liersesteenweg industrial park, Heist-op-den-Berg; permit coverage indicates approval.

name: Orange Belgium Hoboken data center
notes: Hoboken, Antwerp; ~1,000 m2 opened 2019 (built by Artes Group for Orange Belgium). Baxtel lists 3 MW / 10,764 sq ft - largest Antwerp facility. Telco-core DC for Orange mobile traffic; not marketed as public colocation.

name: Google St. Ghislain data center campus
notes: Saint-Ghislain (Hainaut), Google Cloud europe-west1 region anchor; operational. Google announced EUR 5B Belgium AI/cloud infrastructure investment (Oct 2025, through 2027) covering St. Ghislain campus expansion and new Wallonia sites.

name: Google Farciennes data center campus
notes: Ecopole eco-business park spanning Farciennes/Aiseau-Presles/Sambreville near Charleroi (Hainaut). Construction officially launched 5 Apr 2024 (Minister Van der Straeten present); ~EUR 1B investment. Final Walloon permit record (SPW/Wallex) not re-verified this run.

name: Google Feluy-Ecaussinnes data center project
notes: ~36 ha plot in Feluy-Ecaussinnes industrial zone (Hainaut); RTBF reports green light for the Google data center (Nov 2025). High-voltage grid saturated; temporary ORES connection solution until 2029 (ICTMagazine). Permit documents from SPW not re-verified; status recorded as approved per reliable press.

name: LCL Wallonia One (Gembloux)
notes: Former ENGIE Solutions data center in Gembloux (Namur province) acquired and renamed LCL Wallonia One; solar-park expansion at campus confirmed by DCD/ITdaily coverage.

name: Wallonie Data Center (WDC)
notes: Villers-le-Bouillet (Liege province), between Namur and Liege. First Tier III Design certified data center in francophone Belgium (Uptime Institute, Nov 2025); ~1,300 m2, 1,800 on-site PV panels (~10% of consumption). Grown out of the Etix/NRB 'BelgiumDC' project; NRB Group acquired WDC in 2023.

name: Etix Everywhere Belgium DC (BelgiumDC)
notes: Rue de la Science 3, 4530 Villers-le-Bouillet (Liege region). ~900 m2 colocation built with NRB (BelgiumDC project, 2018); ~2 MW power per directory (datacenters.com, C). Likely same campus as Wallonie Data Center - reconcile to avoid double counting.

name: Datacenter United DC Moeskroen/Mouscron
notes: Slachthuisstraat 31, 7700 Moeskroen/Mouscron (Hainaut, Wallonia - not Flanders despite DCU's Flemish-heavy list). Operator page: 'coming soon / under development'. Address from directory (C).
